physicalNotes: Radius 1.166 Jupiter radii from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019 (2019AJ....158...39C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract): 83,359.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.4688 Jupiter masses (Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2019AJ....158...39C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
